about_the_game:
🛎️ ABOUT THE GAME
A semi-survival, 3rd person simulation game that lets you experience staying in a variety of unique hotels around the world — from luxury suites to mysterious and even terrifying accommodations.

🗣️ "Have you ever stayed in a hotel? Do you think all hotels are the same?"

Now it's your turn to find out. Stay in hotels, live the experience, share your reviews, earn money and build your reputation — until you become the ultimate VIP guest in the most luxurious hotels on Earth.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

🎮 Game Modes

🕯️ Story Mode – Deep, Twisted, and Terrifying

Play as a protagonist with a mysterious and painful past, sent to a strange town where each night is a psychological trial.

🗣️ "When a mysterious event pulls VTubers into the real world, they find themselves wandering from one hotel to another — collecting Coins and Glam Points, building their reputation, growing a fanbase, and trying to survive in a world that no longer recognizes them..."

  • Unique random events every night

  • Narrative choices that shape your journey

  • Survive the unexpected and uncover buried secrets

🛏️ Guest Mode – Chill, Relaxing... or is it?

Live the life of a hotel guest with realistic simulations.

  • Stay in a wide variety of hotels

  • Participate in activities like ordering room service, exploring hidden areas, or even discovering forbidden secrets

  • Face random experiences — some delightful, some disturbing

  • Write reviews and let other players know: "Book it or skip it?"

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

⭐ Key Features

  • 🎨 Realistic graphics with immersive first-person perspective (FPS) in Story Mode.

  • 😈 Realistic graphics with immersive 3rd-person perspective (POV) in Guest Mode.

  • 🧍‍♀️ Anime-inspired semi-realistic characters, cute yet mysterious

  • 👥 Engage with NPCs and uncover more than just casual conversations

  • 🧠 Psychological storytelling that constantly makes you question reality

  • 🧺 Loot, farm, and craft system for survival and progression

  • 🗺️ Selectable and expandable maps, with more locations to be added over time

  • 🔄 Multiple endings based on your choices

  • 💾 Multiple save slots and customizable player profiles

  • 📢 Community for Share your stay experiences with other players in and out of the game

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

🛠️ Join the Community

Have feedback, ideas, or bugs to report?
📌 Join our Discord and help shape the world of Guest Simulator together with us!

Thanks for playing our game.
Your stay... might be more than just a night’s sleep.
